title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
claim: Open-source 'personal trading agent' from HKU's data-science lab — one command gives any LLM agent full trading capabilities via MCP: market data, backtesting, multi-agent strategies (MIT, pip-installable).
why_good: Proof retail quants want an agent that trades WITH them, not a black-box bot: 28k★ and 4.6k forks in 4 months, 106 contributors, live Discord/WeChat communities — the strongest demand signal in this domain this year.
value: The lab won't commercialize (academic, MIT) — the opening is the hosted layer it leaves out: broker connectivity, guardrails, strategy marketplace and paid data feeds sold to the audience the repo already aggregated.
risk: Late and crowded: brokers and LLM vendors can ship native 'agent trading', and anything touching live money carries regulatory and blow-up liability a small team may not survive. The repo's fame doesn't transfer to whoever builds on it.

zh.claim: 来自香港大学数据科学实验室的开源“个人交易代理”——只需一条命令即可通过MCP赋予任何LLM代理完整的交易能力：市场数据、回测、多代理策略（MIT，支持pip安装）。
zh.why_good: 证明零售量化交易者希望有一个与他们一起交易的代理，而不是一个黑箱机器人：4个月内获得28k★和4.6k个分支，106位贡献者，活跃的Discord/微信社区——这是今年该领域最强的需求信号。
zh.value: 实验室不会进行商业化（学术，MIT）——机会在于它留下的托管层：经纪商连接、保护措施、策略市场和向已经聚集的受众出售的付费数据源。
zh.risk: 进入市场晚且竞争激烈：经纪商和LLM供应商可以推出原生的“代理交易”，任何涉及真实资金的项目都面临监管和爆炸性责任，小团队可能难以承受。该仓库的知名度并不会转移到基于它构建的任何项目上。
